deployments_detail.use: "Robinhood Cortex" AI investing assistant (real-time analysis, trade ideas, Cortex Digests)

Robinhood Cortex Digests: generative-AI investing assistant that reviews breaking news, analyst reports and technical signals to produce AI-driven stock/asset insights for Gold subscribers. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock); Amazon Nova; Anthropic Claude]

Agentic Trading: customers connect third-party AI agents via Robinhood's AI-native Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to autonomously analyze portfolios, rebalance, backtest strategies and place trades in a dedicated agentic account. [Model Context Protocol (MCP); compatible agents incl. Anthropic Claude / OpenAI ChatGPT]

Next-generation Robinhood Cortex: AI assistant embedded throughout the app that connects news/market shifts to individual holdings and lets users buy/sell equities and crypto, research and explore event contracts via plain-English commands. [Robinhood Cortex (built on Amazon Bedrock)]

Portfolio Digests powered by Cortex: AI-generated personalized portfolio insights delivered multiple times daily, summarizing top movers, upcoming events (earnings, splits) and S&P 500 benchmark comparisons. [Robinhood Cortex]

Acquisition of Pluto Capital, an AI-powered investment research platform, to power personalized/tailored investment strategies feeding Robinhood's managed 'Strategies' offering. [Pluto Capital (acquired)]

Amazon Nova generative-AI adoption for document processing and content generation (alongside fraud investigation), enabling secure model customization without sharing customer data. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock); Amazon Nova]
deployments_detail.value: Up to 80% cost savings vs other models

deployments_detail.use: FinCrimes Agent: a generative-AI agent that synthesizes customer and transactional data into investigative summaries to help analysts investigate financial crimes/suspicious activity more effectively. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock); Anthropic Claude Haiku & Sonnet; DeepSeek]
deployments_detail.value: ~20% cumulative efficiency gain in investigative workflows

deployments_detail.use: Graph-intelligence fraud detection: production system using graph neural networks, graph embeddings, temporal motif networks and an XGBoost user-riskiness classifier to detect identity fraud, account takeovers and first-party fraud across the user journey. [In-house (GNN, XGBoost); AWS DynamoDB graph storage]
AI-generated code across engineering: engineers use AI coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf) so that over half of new code is AI-generated and nearly all engineers use AI to write code. [Cursor; Windsurf]
deployments_detail.value: Over 50% of new code AI-generated; ~100% of engineers using AI tools
